title.en: An Act to Return From the Friar Lands Sinking Fund to the General Unappropriated Surplus of the Insular Government the Sum of One Million three Hundred thousand Pesos as a Partial Reimbursement of the Amounts Appropriated From Said Surplus for Said Sinking Fund.

text.en:
The sum of one million three hundred thousand pesos is hereby returned from the friar lands
sinking fund to the general unappropriated surplus of the Insular Government, as a partial reimbursement of
the amounts heretofore appropriated for said sinking fund from said general unappropriated surplus.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 23, 1914.
